title: Check if libinput is managing devices in Xorg
summary: Verify which input driver Xorg is using for your devices by checking the Xorg log file. This helps confirm if libinput is active or if another driver like synaptics is taking precedence.

aliases.text: which driver is using my mouse

steps.explain: Search the Xorg log file for lines indicating which input driver is being used. Replace <XORG_LOG_PATH> with the path to your log, usually /var/log/Xorg.0.log.

placeholders.name: XORG_LOG_PATH
placeholders.description: Path to the Xorg log file
